source_title: Visual Basic 5.0/6.0 P-Code Public Opcode Table (DotFix Software, 2006-08-25)
note: Sizes are total instruction bytes. -1 = variable length (opcode + u16 payload length + payload). DOC rows inherit the referenced opcode's size. This public table contains known errors; empirical corrections live in opcode_table_overrides.json and are applied by tools/opcode_table.py.
